title: Cloudflare Adds New WAF Rules to Detect Attacks Targeting CVE-2026-111497
content_md: Cloudflare announced an emergency release of its Web Application Firewall (WAF) on October 25, 2026. This update introduces two detection rules for the Brotli vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-111497. These rules specifically target requests that declare Brotli body encoding and traffic accessing the Next.js image optimization endpoint.
